answer_sentences.text: No—the 2024 KFS guidelines say that all new retail and MSME term loans sanctioned on or after October 1, 2024 had to comply.
answer_sentences.quote: "all new retail and MSME term loans sanctioned on or after October 1, 2024, including fresh loans to existing customers, shall comply with the above guidelines in letter and spirit without any exception."

answer_sentences.text: Until then, the extant KFS/Factsheet provisions continued to apply during the interregnum.
answer_sentences.quote: "During the interregnum, the relevant provisions on ‘KFS/Factsheet’ under the extant guidelines shall continue to remain applicable"
